solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old film that's about work

indicators.note: about says the first word is placed around the second, wrapping it

parts.note: read as 'that has', giving the word THAT which then holds the next piece
OP is the usual abbreviation for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone describing a vintage movie as being about labour.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of that's means 'has': THAT has OP about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1935 Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers musical carries this title, so it is an old film.

clue.text: High hill upon North American city

parts.note: a tor is a high rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
upon means on top of, onto

explanation.surface: A lofty hill sitting above a city in North America.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Ontario is Canada's largest city, so it is a North American city.

clue.text: Miniature treat — favourite square describing it?

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing around, so the outer pieces enclose the inner one

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet
four is a square number, two times two
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking whether a favourite square of cake is the dainty miniature being described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of drawing a line round something.
explanation.definitionFit: These are tiny fancy cakes or biscuits served with coffee, a miniature sweet treat.

clue.text: A gentle glowing

parts.note: light can mean gentle, as a light touch

explanation.surface: A soft warm glow.
explanation.definitionFit: Something burning or lit up is glowing, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Hit shot immediately

parts.note: a slap is a hit with the open hand
a bang is the sound of a shot, so it stands for one

explanation.surface: A gunshot strikes its target at once.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal phrase means directly or right away, i.e. at once.

clue.text: First element

definitions.meaning: in front, ahead of everyone, as in a race
the heavy grey metal with symbol Pb

explanation.surface: Talk of the first element in a list or table.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in front means first place, and Pb is a chemical element, the soft heavy metal.

clue.text: Worker splitting open banana

indicators.note: splitting says one piece goes into the middle of another, breaking it apart

parts.note: plain means open or clear, as in plain view
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A labourer prising apart a banana skin.
explanation.definitionFit: The cooking banana of the tropics is a starchy variety of banana.

clue.text: Caribbean island where a dance lacks heart

indicators.note: lacks heart means the central letter of the dance is taken out

parts.note: the rumba is a Cuban ballroom dance

explanation.surface: An island where people dance half-heartedly.
explanation.definitionFit: This Dutch Caribbean island lies off the coast of Venezuela.

clue.text: Chicken — insides removed?

definitions.meaning: chicken as an adjective means cowardly, lacking nerve
read literally, without guts, i.e. with the innards taken out

explanation.surface: A chicken being prepared for the oven with its innards taken out.
explanation.definitionFit: Cowardly people lack guts, and a bird with its guts removed is literally without them.

clue.text: Keep part-timers in check

indicators.note: in says the part-timers go inside the word for check

parts.note: a rein is a check or restraint, as in keep a rein on
the TA, Territorial Army, is Britain's volunteer reserve of part-time soldiers

explanation.surface: Holding part-time staff in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean to continue having or holding something rather than losing it.

clue.text: Poison some drinking water

indicators.note: drinking says the first word takes the second into itself

parts.note: part means some, as in part of it
aqua is Latin for water

explanation.surface: A warning that some of the drinking water is poisoned.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a highly toxic weedkiller, notorious as a poison.

clue.text: Mission accomplished finally, English up to date

parts.note: the Alamo in Texas was a Spanish mission before its famous siege

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of accomplished

explanation.surface: A report that the mission is finally done, brought up to date in English.
explanation.definitionFit: The borrowed French phrase means in the fashion, i.e. fashionable and current.

clue.text: Ridiculous suffering that's hard

parts.note: nuts means crazy or ridiculous
hell is torment or great suffering

explanation.surface: Someone complaining that their absurd ordeal is a tough one.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a thing that's hard, i.e. the hard case of a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: The hard woody casing of a nut is the thing described as being hard.

clue.text: Egghead and chief of clan gas

parts.note: the head of egg is its first letter, E
a thane was a Scottish clan chief or lord, as in Macbeth

explanation.surface: An intellectual and a Highland clan leader, then a gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual but is read as the head of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a colourless flammable hydrocarbon found in natural gas.

clue.text: Leg up, then, for cheese?

parts.note: a stilt is a pole that raises the leg up
on means thereafter, as in from then on

explanation.surface: A pun on getting a leg up, then going for cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: STILTON is a strong English blue cheese; the question mark flags the punning build.
explanation.definitionFit: This blue-veined English variety from Leicestershire is a classic cheese.

clue.text: Musical producer in stereo, bouncing back

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A sound bouncing back and forth in stereo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' marks the letters held within 'stereo, bouncing'; 'back' turns them around.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind instrument produces music, so it is a musical producer.

clue.text: Sense of the blue distortion of mist with sunset

indicators.note: distortion of says the letters of the following words are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A painter capturing a misty sunset under a blue sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' is not a colour here but means rude or smutty.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue jokes are dirty, so the quality of being blue is indecency.

clue.text: Drug deep in her, circulating

indicators.note: circulating says the letters move around into another order

explanation.surface: A drug circulating deep inside a woman's bloodstream.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a stimulant used as a decongestant, a medicinal drug.

clue.text: Oz city where British singer gathering support

indicators.note: gathering says the first piece collects the second within it

parts.note: Adele is the British pop singer
aid means help or support

explanation.surface: A British singer drawing a supportive crowd on an Australian tour.
explanation.definitionFit: Oz is slang for Australia, and this is the capital of South Australia.

clue.text: Usual trick to pen a series of hits

indicators.note: to pen means to enclose, as in a sheep pen, so the outer pieces hold the next

parts.note: par is the normal or usual standard, as in par for the course
to diddle is to swindle or trick

explanation.surface: A writer's usual trick for penning hit songs.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a basic drum rudiment, a set pattern of alternating drumstrokes.

clue.text: Case to select for audio file

parts.note: a pod is the case holding peas or seeds
to cast is to select actors for roles

explanation.surface: Choosing a carrying case for a sound recording.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a downloadable audio programme, distributed as a digital file.

clue.text: A bit of skirt — excuse me!

parts.note: the hem is the bottom edge of a skirt

explanation.surface: An embarrassed cough at the sight of a short skirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bit of skirt' is slang for a woman, but here it is literally part of a skirt.
explanation.definitionFit: The polite throat-clearing noise is used to attract attention, like saying excuse me.

clue.text: Space station with a satellite

parts.note: Mir was the Soviet and Russian space station
and means with, together with

explanation.surface: An orbiting station accompanied by a satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the moons of Uranus, a natural satellite.

clue.text: Suppose example doesn't begin to contain problem?

indicators.note: to contain says the trimmed word holds the next one inside it
doesn't begin says the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a case is an example or instance
a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: Wondering whether an example can't even begin to contain the problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doesn't begin' cuts the C from CASE, leaving ASE, which then holds SUM.
explanation.definitionFit: To take something as given without proof is to suppose it.

clue.text: Golden buckles for attachment to computer

indicators.note: buckles means bends out of shape, so the letters are warped into a new order

explanation.surface: Gold buckles fitted as fasteners on a laptop.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small device plugged into a computer port, an add-on attachment.

clue.text: Slot in macaroni cheese

indicators.note: in says the letters are found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Finding a place for something in a dish of macaroni cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess or a suitable place is a slot, as in a niche market.

clue.text: Think about drink, welcoming prodigal son

indicators.note: welcoming says the drink takes the next piece in

parts.note: cider is a drink made from apples

indicators.note: prodigal means wayward or wandering, so the letters of son stray into a new order

explanation.surface: Reflecting over a drink about welcoming home the prodigal son.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or weigh something up is to think about it.

clue.text: House with trees to climb, initially avoided

indicators.note: in a down clue to climb means the letters read upwards, i.e. backwards
initially avoided says the first letter is dropped

parts.note: limes are trees, also called lindens

explanation.surface: A house with trees that the children are kept from climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: A SEMI is a semi-detached house, sharing one wall with its neighbour, common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-detached home is a kind of house, shortened in British usage.

clue.text: Rash line precedes historical records

indicators.note: precedes says the line comes before the rash in the answer

parts.note: an arc is a curved line
hives is an itchy rash

explanation.surface: A rash line in a medical record.
explanation.definitionFit: Collections of old documents are kept as historical records.

clue.text: I'd run off to grab a tropical fruit

indicators.note: to grab says the shuffled letters seize the next piece and hold it
off means gone bad or out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone fleeing after snatching a piece of exotic fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The notoriously smelly spiky fruit of South-East Asia is a tropical fruit.

clue.text: Electronic instrument present, first of many in metal

indicators.note: in says the pieces go inside the metal

parts.note: tin is a metal
here means present, as in a register

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of many

explanation.surface: A gift of an electronic instrument, mostly made of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the early electronic instrument played by moving hands near two antennae.

clue.text: Roman philosopher making a scene

indicators.note: making means forming something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Roman thinker throwing a tantrum in public.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the Stoic philosopher and tutor to Nero in ancient Rome.
